note: Harper County publishes its zoning only as a PDF zoning map (harpercountyks.gov/appraiser) and a document Article 4 ordinance. The county GIS (harper.integritygis.com, an Integrity GIS viewer) exposes no public ArcGIS REST zoning layer that I could reach; the host did not respond to requests. The only Zoning_Districts FeatureServer found (services.arcgis.com/f4rR7WnIfGBdVYFd) is a different jurisdiction: a query at the county's sample point returns zero features. Anthony (county seat) publishes its code as text with no GIS layer; no city zoning service found for Attica, Anthony or Harper.
